scope: Ordinary drill standing holds through recall, retreat, calm, checkpoint and locality; not whole infantry acceptance

verified_edges.evidence: Cover branch calls doStop then doWatch for fit non-moving team members after its native-command/epoch/generation transaction guards.
Retry branch calls doStop before its committed doMove. It is not standing-hold ownership and must not leave a persistent hold receipt.
Completed/CLOSE branch stops non-stragglers and adds actor membership to state holders; no exact per-actor STOP receipt.
STALLED/TIME_LIMIT/RECOVERY_FAILED under matching support lease stops members without adding ordinary holders; parent assignment owns the next bound. Failure result must remain a failure.
Local e4e8a85e retains refused/nonlocal same-group holders and removes only actors issued follow. It still starts from historical membership, not exact native STOP ownership.

Admits WITHDRAW operation and commits CortexGroupMove before later doFollow/clear of holders. A strict original native-route receipt consumed only at the later recall would reject this self-authored route change.
Clears CBE temporary group route before recalling support/search/ordinary holders. Search recall has its own native MOVE receipt; ordinary holders use neutral-command membership.
Serializes holders membership and searchMoveReceipts; no ordinary per-actor hold command receipt.

Locality passes checkpoint map to calm restoration. Unit-local guards can skip an unavailable actor, while calm terminal cleanup deletes holders/checkpoint. GroupTick retention alone does not repair this boundary.
Shared task guard has no explicit STOP distinction. Calm and bounded remount continuation call it. Unknown STOP and owned hold release cannot safely be conflated.

implementation_contract: Capture immutable per-actor provenance at the actual standing-stop command boundary: original actor/group, issuer token/owner epoch/generation, native command/destination identity, authored order identity and original lifetime/phase. Historical membership cannot manufacture a receipt later.
Separate standing cover, completed hold and failed support-bound role. Keep parent support sequence/lease authority; transient retry stops belong only to their successor MOVE transaction.

Consume/release an exact old hold before changing its native route, or perform an explicit authenticated same-operation route handover. A generic accept-new-route or allow-STOP boolean is not sufficient.
Preserve pending per-actor receipts across checkpoint and actual group/unit ownership gaps. Original clock anchors survive; no local FSM handle replay or JIP deadline renewal.
Check current actual actor/group authority and competing reservations/native tasks at every command boundary. Public metadata is provenance, not remote command authority.
Separate command issued, physical rejoin observed, yielded and unresolved outcomes. Issued follow must not become a physical completion counter.

A finite active hold must explicitly transfer or release at its original lifetime; failed/late cleanup retains unresolved provenance instead of granting a new old command. Passive receipt retention must not install an infinite worker.
Preserve unknown or newer mission STOP. Same-value rewrites cannot be distinguished without controller cooperation and must remain an explicit limitation.
required_engine_cases: Failed support bound to new parent sequence without fabricated success
Unknown STOP and new scripted/equipment/fire task
Group locality before actor locality and reverse order
Original lifetime expiry and unresolved handback
Normal ownership and separate actual-provider HC batch
